summary: Add Blogs pages to Marketing site & Model
acs:
- A Payload CMS collection exists for blog posts with fields for title, slug, excerpt, body, publish date, and author
- All published blog posts are pre-rendered as static pages at build time (no client-side fetch required to view content)
- A Blog Listing page shows all published posts (title, excerpt, publish date) and supports keyword search
- Clicking a post on the listing page opens a public blog detail page rendering the full Payload CMS content
- Draft/unpublished posts in Payload CMS do not appear on the listing or detail pages
- Blog listing and detail pages render correctly on mobile and desktop breakpoints
